title: Julie Murphy
text:
Aviation · Travel · Partnerships

01





I’m a senior leader in aviation, with a career shaped by building strong partnerships, driving strategic growth and representing a globally respected airline brand across the UK, Ireland and EMEA.




At ANA, one of the world’s top-rated airlines, I lead pan-European trade strategy and the UK and Irish markets, collaborating closely across the B2B2C space, from corporate travel to leisure, to deliver commercial success and lasting relationships.



Business development, strategic planning and customer engagement, and equally the softer skills: influence, connection and being able to read the room.



My industry roles keep me connected to the broader direction of aviation and travel, and let me contribute where I can to its growth and progress.





I work at the point where numbers meet nuance, where data informs action, and where partnerships aren’t just transactional, they’re built to last.

04





I’m often asked to speak and sit on panels at industry events. A selection of talks, interviews and coverage:




  
    Irish Travel Trade News · 1 Dec 2025
    Welcome address, Star Alliance Christmas lunch, Dublin
    Welcomed guests on behalf of the Star Alliance partners at the 10th annual lunch at the Shelbourne Hotel.
  

  
    Irish Travel Trade News · 1 Dec 2024
    Co-host and speaker, Star Alliance Christmas lunch, Dublin
    Co-hosted the alliance's annual trade lunch with United Airlines, covering its digital progress and its fifth World Travel Awards win.
  

  
    Irish Travel Trade News · 1 Dec 2023
    Speaker, Star Alliance Christmas lunch, Dublin
    Spoke about the alliance's plans, including digital and mobile innovation and its "Together, Better Connected" tagline.
  

  
    TravelMole · 1 Sept 2023
    ANA's partnership with CLIA UK and Ireland
    Commented for ANA on sponsoring the CLIA Destination Showcase and Cruise Forum as Japan reopened to visitors.
  

  
    Simple Flying · 1 Nov 2021
    Interview: ANA's international rebound
    Japan's inbound tourism goals and how ANA planned to welcome visitors back after the pandemic, including travel beyond Tokyo.
  

  
    ABTA · 1 Aug 2021
    Speaker, ABTA Business Travel Recovery and Trends webinar
    Led the session on business travel sentiment, covering what matters to customers, sustainability and wellbeing.
  

  
    Buying Business Travel · 1 Nov 2019
    Star Alliance evening for travel managers, London
    Represented Star Alliance at a trade event, highlighting its airlines at Heathrow Terminal 2 and its new transfer service.
  

  
    BTNews · 1 Jun 2019
    Star Alliance Connection Service launch at Heathrow
    Quoted as chair of the UK country steering group at the launch of the alliance's Connection Service.
  

  
    Institute of Travel Management · 1 Nov 2018
    Featured speaker, ITM Ireland Conference, Dublin
    Spoke at ITM's annual business travel conference for Ireland at The Westbury.
  

  
    TheDesignAir · 1 Oct 2017
    Interview: Star Alliance at Heathrow Terminal 2
    Interviewed as Star Alliance's UK chair on Terminal 2, the airport experience and the alliance's digital plans.
  

  
    Irish Travel Trade News · 1 Apr 2015
    ANA appoints a general sales agent in Ireland
    Quoted on ANA's appointment of Airline Sales & Marketing in Ireland and its plans to grow business from the Irish market.
